exposure: Women with endometriosis who underwent cesarean section
Women with endometriosis who underwent oocyte retrieval
Women with endometriosis who had spontaneous tubo-ovarian abscesses
cohort: Women with endometriosis and a diagnosis of infectious process between 2009-2012 at a tertiary endometriosis reference center
finding: The study suggests that some complications attributed to ART in women with endometriosis may occur spontaneously and that early surgical drainage with intravenous antibiotics is an effective treatment for tubo-ovarian abscesses in these patients.
